main_text.p: phanius in Ancyroto, Athanasius in Orat. de incarnata Dei Verbi Oeconomia; & ex Schismaticis Georgius Cyprius in Tomo, Demetrius Chrysolora Dialogo Antirrhetico contra Demetrium Cydonium pro Nilo Theffalonicensi, quorum testimonia habes in Hottingero cap. 18. Et hæc de Dogmate, quid de ditione? Non alia. Idem Schismatici in eodem Tomo. Καὶ ἀεσοπήνας, καὶ οἱ Στρυβουλίτες, ἐ τῆς Ἐκκλησίας καταφρονήσαντες ἔπει. Καὶ ἠσπιάδας, τὸν [?]ενεκεν Βασιλέως ἀποσβᾶς ζῶντ[?] παρ' αὐτῶν, Ταυ[?] τῆς ἀσεβείας τολμῶντι. οἱ δὲ ὑπάσαντο [?] ἐν τῇ ὁμολογίᾳ τῶν [?]ρδίων [?]. ἐν αὐτῇ ἡ ἐποιοῦντο καὶ τὸν Θεσαλονίκης. ἐπειδὴ συναλίζεσθαι ἔλεγον κατ' αὐτῶν ἐν πᾳ τ' ἐκ[?] τῆς Βαρλαὰμ, καὶ Ἀ'χίνδυνον ἀπορρήτως ἐνωάθων. Adducti sunt, qui tumultuabantur, & scindebant Ecclesiam, interrogatique, quam ob causam, Imperatore vitam pie agente, ab ipsis contra pietatem similia auderentur. Illi criminati sunt quandam additionem factam in professione Fidei eorum, qui Præsules ordinantur. Insuper accusabant Thessalonicensem, nanque scandalizari sese dicebant de nonnullis, quæ ille aduersus Barlaamum, & Acindynum scribens dixerat. His se culpa liberans Synodus respondit. Ἐπὶ τούτοις ἡ Θεία Σύνοδος πρὸς τὰ φατὰ ἀρχιεράσιν, φησί, πρὸς τὴν Θή-

page.notes: Greek lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution; words marked [?] and the fragments in brackets are uncertain readings, and the Greek should be checked against the original. "Infuper" is printed as such and may be a misprint for "Insuper" (kept as printed in the Latin, with the spelling "Insuper" used in the transcription). "dead" before "ditione" is doubtful. The Latin "profifsione" reads as "professione" from the ligature. The page number is printed as "45o", transcribed as 450. The right-hand dark strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
